content: React Native platform-specific extension resolution (.web.js/.native.js) is bundler-driven; Metro resolves all static imports even ones not executed at runtime for the active platform, so a .web.jsx counterpart must exist with a matching export shape or web builds break on native-only imports (e.g. react-native-maps). Metro (native) and the web bundler differ enough that behavior parity across variants isn't guaranteed by the type system.
